categories.main_business_segments: Shandong Ruifeng Polymer Materials Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the production and sales of plastic additives, including PVC additives (ACR, MBS, MC), engineering plastic additives (PC/ABS toughening agents, ABS high rubber powder, ASA rubber powder), and biodegradable polymer materials such as PBAT and PLA. The company also engages in the development and production of synthetic rubber and bio-based materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced polymer synthesis and modification technologies, including graft copolymerization for MBS resins and proprietary environmentally friendly synthesis processes for MC additives. It has a strong R&D capability with over 68 patents, including 48 invention patents, and operates high-automation production lines. The company also invests in pilot and industrial-scale production of biodegradable polymers and new energy battery materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in PVC pipe and profile, flooring, packaging, medical, automotive, electronics, and construction industries. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with approximately 20% of sales from exports. Its products are used in downstream plastic products requiring enhanced processing, impact resistance, and environmental compliance.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with production facilities in Shandong Province's Yiyuan and Linyi chemical industrial parks. It also has subsidiaries in Vietnam and exports products internationally, including to the US and other countries, though US sales represent less than 0.5% of revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ruifeng operates primarily in the midstream segment of the polymer materials supply chain, producing chemical additives and polymer resins that are sold to downstream plastic product manufacturers. It sources petrochemical raw materials and supplies functional additives and biodegradable polymers to plastic processors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on innovation in high-performance plastic additives and biodegradable polymers, expanding engineering plastic additives and new energy battery materials. It emphasizes green, efficient, multifunctional products aligned with national sustainability policies. R&D priorities include low molecular weight, migration-resistant ACR additives, high-flow MBS resins, bio-based materials like dextran, and black phosphorus industrialization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of plastic additives and polymer materials. Sales are conducted via order-based transactions to industrial customers domestically and internationally. The company adjusts pricing flexibly in response to raw material cost fluctuations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in PVC additives with strong market share and scale advantages. It competes with domestic firms like Nichika Chemical and Shandong Donglin in ACR products, and with Japanese, Korean, and Western companies in MBS and engineering plastic additives. It pursues differentiation through technology and product quality to avoid price wars.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2 billion, a 12.66% increase year-over-year, but net profit attributable to shareholders declined by 74.12% due to raw material price volatility, increased depreciation from new assets, and asset impairment. Total assets were RMB 2.29 billion with stable equity. The company is investing in capacity expansion and new product lines to drive future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ruifeng emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced plastic additives with superior processing performance, impact resistance, and environmental compliance. Its products offer customization and innovation to meet diverse customer needs, supported by strong R&D and patent protection. The company leverages scale, automation, and brand reputation ('Lushan' trademark) to maintain competitive advantage.
